scope: Denver, Colorado; local-moving landing page and linked public profiles.

metrics.label: Instagram followers shown
metrics.context: Public profile count at the snapshot; not a measure of reach or engagement.

observations.title: Fix the hero estimate anchor
observations.observed: The hero estimate button targets #orm and remained at the hero when clicked. The header’s #form link scrolled to the estimate form.
observations.improvement: Point estimate buttons to the working form anchor. Verify keyboard focus and scrolling on mobile before treating that path as tested.

observations.title: Make the text-message choice unambiguous
observations.observed: The form’s accessible text says submission agrees to texts, while the same form offers both agreement and a no-text option.
observations.improvement: Review visible copy, accessible labels and actual handling for one consistent choice. This is a clarity suggestion, not a legal-compliance finding.

sources.label: Local-moving page / estimate anchor and form

limitations: Estimate links were tested without data entry or submission. Text delivery and consent storage were not tested.
Follower count is dated; complete posting history, reach and engagement were not established.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
